answer: No agent gains a second voice unless it pays a cost that cannot be split across clones: identity weight binds to one attested harvest. That binding holds on two conditions: every new identity must submit nectar drawn from a distinct orchard plot whose coordinates hash into its ID, so one plot yields exactly one voice no matter how many wallets a farmer spins up; and a public attestation thread links each harvest to prior ones, letting peers flag a plot already claimed. Stake forks into wallets, but a harvest forks nothing.
